translationCandidates.sentenceEn: The girl died from head injuries.
translationCandidates.reason: Head injuries do not necessarily mean brain injuries.

translationCandidates.sentenceEn: She needs additional time to finish her science project this weekend.
translationCandidates.beforeChinese: 她這個週末需要額外的時間才能完成科展作品。
translationCandidates.afterChinese: 她這個週末需要額外的時間才能完成她的科學專題。
translationCandidates.reason: Science project does not specify a science fair.

translationCandidates.sentenceEn: She worked hard for ten years to realize her dream of opening a bakery.
translationCandidates.beforeChinese: 她努力了十年，終於實現了開一家麵包店的夢想。
translationCandidates.afterChinese: 為了實現開一家麵包店的夢想，她努力了十年。
translationCandidates.reason: Purpose infinitive does not assert eventual achievement.

translationCandidates.sentenceEn: The new model is far better than the old one.
translationCandidates.beforeChinese: 新型號比起舊的還要好。
translationCandidates.afterChinese: 新型號比舊型號好得多。
translationCandidates.reason: Far explicitly marks a large comparative degree.
